invariants: personal and shared graph views persist tenant-scoped query, layout, visibility and revision in PostgreSQL
browser-local drafts remain importable during compatibility but are never labelled platform-saved
formal graph export uses an asynchronous checksum-verified object job and never a browser-only Blob as evidence
domain.compensation: archive the current view revision or cancel the export job while retaining history and audit

data.migration: additive graph_saved_views, graph_view_history, graph_export_jobs and object manifest migration required

negative_tests: cross-tenant personal or shared view cannot be listed or imported
viewer cannot publish or overwrite a shared view without write authority
export object cannot be downloaded after expiry or manifest mismatch

stop_conditions: view conflict, export size, queue lag or object generation budget is exceeded

tests: G5 Windows Chrome cross-device restore and download
evidence: a second browser restores the same revisioned platform view and a formal export matches its query snapshot and object manifest
